scientific_limits: One-dimensional, driftless free Brownian motion; same-diffusivity OU first-hit return; independent renewal exploration clocks.
Explicit spatial tail amplitudes are for Pareto survival (1+t)^(-delta) with delta>1; general-clock moment equivalences require ET<infty.
No finite-time rates, higher-dimensional or stochastic-clock dependence beyond independent i.i.d. durations.

value.rationale: The natural measurable distinction between free search and noisy recapture is characterized sharply: two different Pareto exponents and constants, two moment thresholds separated by two orders, and an explicit positive-recurrent regime with divergent overall variance yet finite harmonic-phase energy. This phase-resolved structure is not supplied by generic instantaneous Pareto reset results or the previously known harmonic energy identity. The Pareto release clock is a canonical heavy-tail family, not a contrived parameter slice.
